name: Mobile Crane
instructions: omr/instructions/855-1/ (scans; the crane is pages 1-13, the tipper truck after)

functions.does: The cab slews round on its turntable, carrying the boom with it.
The crank at the front of the cab's left side raises and lowers the boom: two racks slide under the cab and push the boom up on two struts.
functions.source: book: cab steps 7-9 and 17, boom step 14

functions.does: The crank at the back of the cab's left side winds the winch, raising or lowering the hook, which hangs on its string over a pulley at the boom tip and round its own pulley.
functions.source: book: cab steps 8 and 10, chassis step 10

functions.does: The crank high on the cab's right side, on the boom's pivot axle, extends the boom's blue inner section: a crown gear and a shaft with two universal joints inside the boom drive a gear at the boom tip, which drives the rack under the blue section.
functions.source: book: boom steps 5-6, 9 and 13 (the inset shows the gears)

functions.does: The four outriggers slide out on tiles and stand on their feet.
The four road wheels roll freely; there's no steering.
The four black window shutters on the chassis sides swing open.
The hook hangs straight down beneath the boom tip as the cab slews and the boom luffs.
A ratchet holds the boom up: the yellow lever's pawl rests on the luffing gears, so the boom can be raised, and lifting the lever lets it be lowered.
functions.source: book: cab steps 14 and 17; what it does from the user
functions.skip: only resists gravity; the luffing crank works both ways without it

functions.does: The rubber band pulls the ratchet's lever down onto the gears.
functions.skip: only resists gravity; drawn, and should stay on the cab as it slews
